Expressions

Each expression below must remain in one table cell. Backslashes and backticks are literal syntax rather than extra columns or new formatting instructions.

ExpressionMeaning
a | bUnion
a \| bLiteral backslash
`left` | `right`Quoted operands
x | yAlternatives
